item.title: Russia and North Korea open the first road across their shared border
item.description: Connection across Tumen River is further sign of closer ties between the two countries since start of war in Ukraine Russia and North Korea have opened the first road bridge across their shared border , in the latest sign of the rapidly deepening ties between the two countries since the start of the war in Ukraine. The one-kilometre bridge spans the Tumen River between Khasan in Russia’s far east and Tumangang in North Korea, along a remote and sparsely populated stretch of the countries’ shared border just a few miles from the coast. item.description: Nearly a century ago, a single colony of Staphylococcus aureus (S. aureus) helped launch the antibiotic age. item.title: 3569 reproducciones · 79 reacciones | Rússia - Pelo menos 11 pessoas morreram e outras seis ficaram feridas após uma avalanche atingir um grupo de alpinistas na região de Kabardino-Balkaria, no norte do Cáucaso, na Rússia, informaram os serviços de emergência locais. A avalanche desceu do Monte Mizhirgi, um dos picos mais altos do Cáucaso Norte russo, por volta das 17h, horário local (14h GMT), no domingo (6), atingindo um grupo de 33 alpinistas. Às 9h da manhã, horário local, de segunda-feira, 10 alpinistas haviam conseguido descer a montanha por conta própria, enquanto o paradeiro de outros seis permanecia desconhecido, informaram os serviços de emergência. Mais de 50 socorristas participaram da operação de busca e resgate, mas os esforços foram dificultados pelo terreno acidentado e pelo alto risco de novas avalanches, disseram eles. item.title: War drama Pressure depicts D‑day's weather forecast—what we found when we recreated the challenge using modern systems
item.description: Meteorologist James Stagg gave what many regard as the most important weather forecast in history in June 1944. The fate of more than 150,000 Allied troops preparing to invade the Normandy beaches on D-Day and the future of the war in Europe depended on Stagg and his forecasting teams. Get the forecast wrong and an already perilous invasion might not succeed, prolonging the war. In the briefing room at Southwick House near Portsmouth, waiting for the forecast, sat General Dwight D. Eisenhower. Fuente: Phys.org.
